responsibility: This file is the implementation of libgccjit’s public C API and the main boundary between external callers and the internal C++ recording/playback engine. It defines the opaque public handle types as subclasses of recording and result classes, performs defensive argument validation and error reporting at each gcc_jit_* entrypoint, and forwards object construction, IR-building, compilation, result lookup, option handling, timers, diagnostics, and extended-asm operations to the underlying recording context machinery. It is the library’s ABI-facing wrapper layer rather than a single compilation stage implementation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/libgccjit.h, which declares the installable public C ABI, and gcc/jit/docs/_build/texinfo/libgccjit.texi, which is the generated manual, this same-stem .c file is the runtime wrapper layer that defines the opaque handle subclasses, validates gcc_jit_* calls, and forwards them into the internal recording/result machinery.
